```{r}
# ============================================================
# 01_get_top20_scale_items_and_text_symptoms.R
#
# Purpose:
#   1. Calculate top 20 high-score scale items among pure depression cases
#   2. Calculate top 20 medical-record symptoms among pure depression cases
#   3. Export clean input tables for later overlap and plotting analyses
#
# Notes:
#   - scale_item_to_symptom_filled.xlsx only needs:
#       item_id, coarser_symptom
#   - symptom_to_expression_all_text_symptoms.xlsx only needs:
#       coarser_symptom, expression
#   - coarser_symptom names are preserved exactly, including "#"
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
# ============================================================
# 0. Paths
# ============================================================

dep_questionnaire_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_Depression_Pure.xlsx")
dep_record_file        <- here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx")

item_map_file <- here("data", "scale_item_to_symptom_filled.xlsx")
expr_file     <- here("data", "symptom_to_expression_all_text_symptoms.xlsx")

out_dir <- here("OUTPUT", "salient_item_text_top20")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "Top20_scale_items_and_text_symptoms.xlsx")

# ============================================================
# 1. Define item lists and scoring rules
# ============================================================

DSRSC_items <- paste0("DSRSC", 1:18)
PHQ_items   <- paste0("PHQ", 1:9)
CDI_items   <- paste0("CDI", c(1:25, 27))  # CDI26 is not scored

DASS_dep_items <- c(
  "DASS3", "DASS5", "DASS10",
  "DASS13", "DASS16", "DASS17", "DASS21"
)

CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10", "CDI11", "CDI13",
  "CDI15", "CDI16", "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Helper functions
# ============================================================

score_questionnaire_items <- function(dat) {
  DSRSC_items_i <- intersect(DSRSC_items, names(dat))
  PHQ_items_i   <- intersect(PHQ_items, names(dat))
  CDI_items_i   <- intersect(CDI_items, names(dat))
  DASS_items_i  <- intersect(DASS_dep_items, names(dat))

  all_item_cols_i <- c(DSRSC_items_i, PHQ_items_i, CDI_items_i, DASS_items_i)

  cat("DSRSC items:", length(DSRSC_items_i), "\n")
  cat("PHQ items:", length(PHQ_items_i), "\n")
  cat("CDI scored items:", length(CDI_items_i), "\n")
  cat("DASS depression items:", length(DASS_items_i), "\n")

  dat_scored <- dat %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(all_item_cols_i), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(DSRSC_items_i, PHQ_items_i, CDI_items_i)), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(DASS_items_i), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(intersect(DSRSC_reverse_items, names(.))), ~ 2 - .x)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(intersect(CDI_reverse_items, names(.))), ~ 2 - .x))

  list(
    dat_scored = dat_scored,
    item_cols = all_item_cols_i
  )
}


make_item_long <- function(dat_scored, item_cols) {
  dat_scored %>%
    select(ID, all_of(item_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(item_cols),
      names_to = "item_id",
      values_to = "score"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      item_id = str_squish(as.character(item_id)),
      scale = case_when(
        str_detect(item_id, "^DSRSC") ~ "DSRSC",
        str_detect(item_id, "^PHQ")   ~ "PHQ-9",
        str_detect(item_id, "^CDI")   ~ "CDI",
        str_detect(item_id, "^DASS")  ~ "DASS-Depression",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      high_score = case_when(
        scale %in% c("DSRSC", "CDI") ~ score == 2,
        scale %in% c("PHQ-9", "DASS-Depression") ~ score >= 2,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    )
}


match_expressions_nonoverlap <- function(text, expressions) {
  if (is.na(text) || length(expressions) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  expressions <- expressions[!is.na(expressions) & expressions != ""]
  expressions <- unique(expressions)

  if (length(expressions) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  # Longest expressions first:
  # e.g., match "容易哭" before "哭"
  expressions <- expressions[order(nchar(expressions), decreasing = TRUE)]

  work_text <- text
  hits <- character(0)

  for (expr in expressions) {
    loc <- gregexpr(expr, work_text, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

    if (loc[1] != -1) {
      hits <- c(hits, expr)

      # Mask matched expression to avoid shorter expressions matching inside it
      mask <- strrep("█", nchar(expr))
      work_text <- gsub(expr, mask, work_text, fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }

  unique(hits)
}

# ============================================================
# 3. Read item-to-symptom mapping
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(item_map_file)) {
  stop("Item mapping file not found: ", item_map_file)
}

item_map <- read_excel(item_map_file) %>%
  mutate(
    item_id = str_squish(as.character(item_id)),
    coarser_symptom = str_squish(as.character(coarser_symptom))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(item_id), item_id != "",
    !is.na(coarser_symptom), coarser_symptom != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(item_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Item-to-symptom mapping rows:", nrow(item_map), "\n")
cat("Mapped unique symptoms:", n_distinct(item_map$coarser_symptom), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 4. Top 20 scale items among pure depression cases
# ============================================================

raw_dep <- read_excel(dep_questionnaire_file) %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Pure depression questionnaire N:", nrow(raw_dep), "\n")

scored_obj <- score_questionnaire_items(raw_dep)
dat_scored <- scored_obj$dat_scored
all_item_cols <- scored_obj$item_cols

item_long <- make_item_long(dat_scored, all_item_cols)

item_high_summary <- item_long %>%
  group_by(scale, item_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depression = sum(!is.na(score)),
    n_high = sum(high_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_score_rate = n_high / n_depression,
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score = min(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score = max(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(high_score_rate), scale, item_id) %>%
  left_join(item_map, by = "item_id")

unmapped_items <- item_high_summary %>%
  filter(is.na(coarser_symptom) | coarser_symptom == "") %>%
  arrange(scale, item_id)

if (nrow(unmapped_items) > 0) {
  warning("Some items have no coarser_symptom mapping. See sheet: Unmapped_items")
}

top20_scale_items <- item_high_summary %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  mutate(top20_rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    top20_rank,
    scale,
    item_id,
    coarser_symptom,
    n_depression,
    n_high,
    high_score_rate,
    mean_score,
    sd_score,
    min_score,
    max_score
  )

top20_scale_symptom_summary <- top20_scale_items %>%
  filter(!is.na(coarser_symptom), coarser_symptom != "") %>%
  count(coarser_symptom, name = "n_top20_items_mapped_to_symptom") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_top20_items_mapped_to_symptom), coarser_symptom)

cat("Top 20 scale items calculated.\n")
cat("Top 20 scale items mapped to",
    n_distinct(top20_scale_items$coarser_symptom),
    "unique coarser symptoms.\n")

# ============================================================
# 5. Read text symptom-expression mapping
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(expr_file)) {
  stop("Expression mapping file not found: ", expr_file)
}

expr_raw <- read_excel(expr_file)

# Allow either "expression" or accidental "expressiond"
if (!"expression" %in% names(expr_raw) && "expressiond" %in% names(expr_raw)) {
  expr_raw <- expr_raw %>%
    rename(expression = expressiond)
}

if (!all(c("coarser_symptom", "expression") %in% names(expr_raw))) {
  stop("Expression file must contain columns: coarser_symptom and expression")
}

expr_map <- expr_raw %>%
  mutate(
    coarser_symptom = str_squish(as.character(coarser_symptom)),
    expression = str_squish(as.character(expression))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(coarser_symptom), coarser_symptom != "",
    !is.na(expression), expression != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(coarser_symptom, expression)

cat("Expression mapping pairs:", nrow(expr_map), "\n")
cat("Unique text symptoms:", n_distinct(expr_map$coarser_symptom), "\n")

# Check overlapping expressions within same symptom.
overlap_expression_check <- expr_map %>%
  inner_join(expr_map, by = "coarser_symptom", suffix = c("_short", "_long")) %>%
  filter(
    expression_short != expression_long,
    nchar(expression_short) < nchar(expression_long),
    str_detect(expression_long, fixed(expression_short))
  ) %>%
  arrange(coarser_symptom, expression_short, expression_long)

# ============================================================
# 6. Top 20 text symptoms among pure depression medical records
# ============================================================

cmp_dep <- read_excel(dep_record_file) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(门诊ID),
    history_text = as.character(现病史)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ID), ID != "",
    !is.na(history_text),
    str_squish(history_text) != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(ID, history_text, everything())

cat("Pure depression medical-record N:", nrow(cmp_dep), "\n")

symptom_expr_list <- expr_map %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    expressions = list(unique(expression)),
    expressions_display = paste(unique(expression), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

participant_symptom_hits <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(symptom_expr_list)), function(i) {
  symptom_i <- symptom_expr_list$coarser_symptom[i]
  exprs_i <- symptom_expr_list$expressions[[i]]
  exprs_disp_i <- symptom_expr_list$expressions_display[i]

  cmp_dep %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      coarser_symptom = symptom_i,
      expressions_used = exprs_disp_i,
      matched_expressions = map_chr(
        history_text,
        ~ paste(match_expressions_nonoverlap(.x, exprs_i), collapse = "; ")
      ),
      medical_record_mentioned = matched_expressions != ""
    )
})

text_symptom_mention_rates <- participant_symptom_hits %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom, expressions_used) %>%
  summarise(
    n_depression_records = n_distinct(ID),
    n_medical_record_mentioned = sum(medical_record_mentioned, na.rm = TRUE),
    medical_record_mention_rate = n_medical_record_mentioned / n_depression_records,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(medical_record_mention_rate), coarser_symptom)

top20_text_symptoms <- text_symptom_mention_rates %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  mutate(top20_rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    top20_rank,
    coarser_symptom,
    n_depression_records,
    n_medical_record_mentioned,
    medical_record_mention_rate,
    expressions_used
  )

cat("Top 20 text symptoms calculated.\n")

# ============================================================
# 7. ID check only, not used for filtering
# ============================================================

id_check <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Questionnaire_Depression_Pure unique IDs",
    "Complains_output_depression_pure unique IDs",
    "Common IDs between the two files",
    "IDs in questionnaire but not in medical records",
    "IDs in medical records but not in questionnaire"
  ),
  n = c(
    n_distinct(raw_dep$ID),
    n_distinct(cmp_dep$ID),
    length(intersect(raw_dep$ID, cmp_dep$ID)),
    length(setdiff(raw_dep$ID, cmp_dep$ID)),
    length(setdiff(cmp_dep$ID, raw_dep$ID))
  )
)

print(id_check)

# ============================================================
# 8. Export
# ============================================================

write.xlsx(
  list(
    ID_check = id_check,
    Full_item_high_score_rates = item_high_summary,
    Top20_scale_items = top20_scale_items,
    Top20_scale_symptom_summary = top20_scale_symptom_summary,
    Unmapped_items = unmapped_items,
    Full_text_symptom_mention_rates = text_symptom_mention_rates,
    Top20_text_symptoms = top20_text_symptoms,
    Expression_mapping_used = expr_map,
    Overlap_expression_check = overlap_expression_check
  ),
  out_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Depression_item_scores_long = item_long,
    Participant_text_symptom_hits = participant_symptom_hits
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "Long_data_for_checking.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Done.\n")
cat("Exported:\n")
cat("  ", out_file, "\n")
cat("  ", file.path(out_dir, "Long_data_for_checking.xlsx"), "\n")
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9. Plot response distributions for selected items
#
# Purpose:
#   Plot 6 representative items:
#   - 3 items from symptom domains shared by scale top items and text top symptoms
#   - 3 items from scale-only symptom domains
#
# Data:
#   OUTPUT/Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx
#
# Notes:
#   - This plot uses all labelled questionnaire data:
#       Depression vs Non-depression
#   - No non-depression subsampling is used.
#   - Symptom names in Chinese are kept for traceability.
#   - English labels are used for figure display.
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.1 Input file for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_scale_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.2 Selected items for plotting
#     A-C: shared with medical-record top symptoms
#     D-F: scale-only symptoms
# ------------------------------------------------------------

selected_items <- tibble::tribble(
  ~panel_id, ~item_id, ~overlap_group, ~coarser_symptom, ~symptom_label_en,
  "A", "DASS13", "Shared with records", "抑郁情绪#", "Depressed mood",
  "B", "DASS5",  "Shared with records", "能量丧失/精力不足/能量增加", "Loss of energy",
  "C", "PHQ4",   "Shared with records", "疲惫感", "Fatigue",
  "D", "DASS10", "Scale-only",          "无望感", "Feeling of hopelessness",
  "E", "PHQ6",   "Scale-only",          "失败感/成就感", "Feeling of failure",
  "F", "CDI24",  "Scale-only",          "自卑/自信#", "Inferiority/Self-confidence"
) %>%
  mutate(
    item_order = row_number(),
    panel_label = paste0(
      panel_id, ". ",
      item_id, ": ",
      symptom_label_en
    )
  )

selected_item_ids <- selected_items$item_id

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.3 Read and score labelled questionnaire data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_dat_raw <- read_excel(plot_scale_file) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Depression_status = as.character(Depression_status)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Depression_status %in% c("Depression", "Non-depression")
  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Plotting sample N:", nrow(plot_dat_raw), "\n")
print(table(plot_dat_raw$Depression_status))

missing_selected_items <- setdiff(selected_item_ids, names(plot_dat_raw))

if (length(missing_selected_items) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These selected items are missing from Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx: ",
    paste(missing_selected_items, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Reuse the scoring function defined above
plot_dat_scored <- score_questionnaire_items(plot_dat_raw)$dat_scored

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.4 Long-format item scores for selected items
# ------------------------------------------------------------

selected_item_scores_long <- plot_dat_scored %>%
  select(ID, Depression_status, all_of(selected_item_ids)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected_item_ids),
    names_to = "item_id",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  mutate(
    item_id = str_squish(as.character(item_id)),
    score = as.integer(score),
    score_label = factor(as.character(score), levels = as.character(0:3)),
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      Depression_status,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(selected_items, by = "item_id") %>%
  mutate(
    panel_label = factor(panel_label, levels = selected_items$panel_label),
    overlap_group = factor(
      overlap_group,
      levels = c("Shared with records", "Scale-only")
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.5 Calculate response proportions
#     Vertical grouped bars:
#       x = item score
#       y = proportion within diagnosis group
#       bars = Depression vs Non-depression
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 给每个 item 定义可能的分数范围：
# DSRSC/CDI: 0-2
# PHQ/DASS: 0-3
selected_item_score_grid <- selected_items %>%
  mutate(
    max_score = case_when(
      str_detect(item_id, "^DSRSC") ~ 2L,
      str_detect(item_id, "^CDI")   ~ 2L,
      str_detect(item_id, "^PHQ")   ~ 3L,
      str_detect(item_id, "^DASS")  ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ max(selected_item_scores_long$score, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(score = list(0:max_score)) %>%
  unnest(score) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(item_id, score)

response_dist <- selected_item_scores_long %>%
  group_by(
    panel_label,
    item_id,
    overlap_group,
    coarser_symptom,
    symptom_label_en,
    diagnosis_group,
    score
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    selected_item_score_grid %>%
      tidyr::crossing(
        diagnosis_group = factor(
          c("Non-depression", "Depression"),
          levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
        )
      ),
    by = c("item_id", "score", "diagnosis_group")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    selected_items %>%
      select(item_id, panel_label, overlap_group, coarser_symptom, symptom_label_en),
    by = "item_id",
    suffix = c("", ".selected")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    panel_label = coalesce(panel_label, panel_label.selected),
    overlap_group = coalesce(overlap_group, overlap_group.selected),
    coarser_symptom = coalesce(coarser_symptom, coarser_symptom.selected),
    symptom_label_en = coalesce(symptom_label_en, symptom_label_en.selected),
    n = coalesce(n, 0L),
    score_label = factor(as.character(score), levels = as.character(0:3)),
    panel_label = factor(panel_label, levels = selected_items$panel_label),
    overlap_group = factor(
      overlap_group,
      levels = c("Shared with records", "Scale-only")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    panel_label,
    item_id,
    overlap_group,
    coarser_symptom,
    symptom_label_en,
    diagnosis_group,
    score,
    score_label,
    n
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    panel_label,
    item_id,
    overlap_group,
    coarser_symptom,
    symptom_label_en,
    diagnosis_group
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n = sum(n),
    prop = if_else(total_n > 0, n / total_n, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.6 Plot: vertical grouped response distributions
#     Panel titles use A-F labels.
#     Group information is explained in the figure caption.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jama_like_colors <- c(
  "Non-depression" = "#4E79A7",
  "Depression" = "#E15759"
)

p_selected_items <- ggplot(
  response_dist,
  aes(x = score_label, y = prop, fill = diagnosis_group)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    width = 0.62,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel_label, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 0.75),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.75, 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = jama_like_colors,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Item score",
    y = "Participants, %"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 1.05
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.0, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 8, b = 6, l = 8)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(colour = NA)
    )
  )

print(p_selected_items)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.7 Export figure and external figure caption
# ------------------------------------------------------------

figure_caption <- paste0(
  "Response distributions for selected scale items among participants with and without ",
  "psychiatrist-diagnosed depression. Panels A-C show items mapped to symptom domains ",
  "that were also among the 20 most frequently documented medical-record symptoms. ",
  "Panels D-F show items mapped to scale-only symptom domains. Bars indicate the ",
  "proportion of participants in each diagnosis group endorsing each item score."
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_AtoF.pdf"),
  plot = p_selected_items,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 6.4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_AtoF.png"),
  plot = p_selected_items,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 6.4,
  dpi = 600
)

writeLines(
  figure_caption,
  con = file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_caption.txt")
)

cat("Selected item distribution figure exported:\n")
cat("  ", file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_AtoF.pdf"), "\n")
cat("  ", file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_AtoF.png"), "\n")
cat("Figure caption exported:\n")
cat("  ", file.path(out_dir, "six_selected_item_response_distributions_caption.txt"), "\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 10. Mention rates for top 20 text symptoms by diagnosis group
#
# Purpose:
#   Calculate medical-record mention rates for the top 20 text symptoms
#   separately in:
#     - Depression
#     - Non-depression
#
# Notes:
#   - Uses all non-depression medical records.
#   - Mention is defined at participant level:
#       at least one expression mapped to a symptom appears in the record.
#   - No plotting, no statistical tests, no overlap classification.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.1 Input files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nondep_record_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_non_depression.xlsx")

if (!file.exists(nondep_record_file)) {
  stop("Non-depression medical-record file not found: ", nondep_record_file)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.2 Read depression and non-depression medical records
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_record_file <- function(file, group_label) {
  read_excel(file) %>%
    mutate(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      history_text = as.character(现病史),
      diagnosis_group = group_label
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ID), ID != "",
      !is.na(history_text),
      str_squish(history_text) != ""
    ) %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(ID, diagnosis_group, history_text)
}

dep_records_for_mention <- read_record_file(
  dep_record_file,
  group_label = "Depression"
)

nondep_records_for_mention <- read_record_file(
  nondep_record_file,
  group_label = "Non-depression"
)

records_for_mention <- bind_rows(
  dep_records_for_mention,
  nondep_records_for_mention
) %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      diagnosis_group,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  )

cat("Medical-record sample for mention-rate analysis:\n")
print(table(records_for_mention$diagnosis_group))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.3 Build expression list for top 20 text symptoms
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top20_text_expr_list <- expr_map %>%
  semi_join(
    top20_text_symptoms %>% select(coarser_symptom),
    by = "coarser_symptom"
  ) %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    expressions = list(unique(expression)),
    expressions_display = paste(unique(expression), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    top20_text_symptoms %>%
      select(
        top20_rank,
        coarser_symptom
      ),
    by = "coarser_symptom"
  ) %>%
  arrange(top20_rank)

# Check whether all top 20 text symptoms have expressions
missing_top20_expr <- top20_text_symptoms %>%
  anti_join(top20_text_expr_list, by = "coarser_symptom")

if (nrow(missing_top20_expr) > 0) {
  warning("Some top 20 text symptoms have no expressions in expr_map.")
  print(missing_top20_expr)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.4 Participant-level mention indicators
# ------------------------------------------------------------

participant_top20_text_hits_by_group <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(top20_text_expr_list)),
  function(i) {
    symptom_i <- top20_text_expr_list$coarser_symptom[i]
    rank_i <- top20_text_expr_list$top20_rank[i]
    exprs_i <- top20_text_expr_list$expressions[[i]]
    exprs_disp_i <- top20_text_expr_list$expressions_display[i]

    records_for_mention %>%
      transmute(
        ID,
        diagnosis_group,
        top20_rank = rank_i,
        coarser_symptom = symptom_i,
        expressions_used = exprs_disp_i,
        matched_expressions = map_chr(
          history_text,
          ~ paste(match_expressions_nonoverlap(.x, exprs_i), collapse = "; ")
        ),
        medical_record_mentioned = matched_expressions != ""
      )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.5 Mention rates by diagnosis group
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top20_text_mention_rates_by_group <- participant_top20_text_hits_by_group %>%
  group_by(
    top20_rank,
    coarser_symptom,
    diagnosis_group,
    expressions_used
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_records = n_distinct(ID),
    n_mentioned = sum(medical_record_mentioned, na.rm = TRUE),
    mention_rate = n_mentioned / n_records,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(top20_rank, diagnosis_group)

top20_text_mention_rates_wide <- top20_text_mention_rates_by_group %>%
  select(
    top20_rank,
    coarser_symptom,
    diagnosis_group,
    n_records,
    n_mentioned,
    mention_rate
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = diagnosis_group,
    values_from = c(n_records, n_mentioned, mention_rate),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mention_rate_difference =
      mention_rate_Depression - `mention_rate_Non-depression`
  ) %>%
  arrange(top20_rank)

print(top20_text_mention_rates_wide)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.6 Export results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mention_rate_out_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "top20_text_symptom_mention_rates_by_diagnosis.xlsx"
)

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Mention_rates_long = top20_text_mention_rates_by_group,
    Mention_rates_wide = top20_text_mention_rates_wide,
    Participant_level_hits = participant_top20_text_hits_by_group
  ),
  mention_rate_out_file,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Top 20 text symptom mention rates by diagnosis exported:\n")
cat("  ", mention_rate_out_file, "\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 11. Ranked back-to-back bar chart, English labels
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.1 Files and labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_scale_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx")
dep_record_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx")
nondep_record_file <- here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_non_depression.xlsx")
symptom_label_file <- here("data", "symptom_label_en.xlsx")

out_dir <- here("OUTPUT", "salient_item_text_top20")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

symptom_label_map <- read_excel(symptom_label_file) %>%
  transmute(
    coarser_symptom = str_squish(as.character(coarser_symptom)),
    symptom_label_en = str_squish(as.character(symptom_label_en))
  ) %>%
  filter(coarser_symptom != "", symptom_label_en != "") %>%
  distinct(coarser_symptom, .keep_all = TRUE)

ranked_colors <- c(
  "Non-depression" = "#4E79A7",
  "Depression" = "#E15759"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.2 Questionnaire item rates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

q_raw <- read_excel(plot_scale_file) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Depression_status = as.character(Depression_status)
  ) %>%
  filter(Depression_status %in% c("Depression", "Non-depression")) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

q_scored_obj <- score_questionnaire_items(q_raw)
q_scored <- q_scored_obj$dat_scored
q_item_cols <- q_scored_obj$item_cols

q_item_long <- q_scored %>%
  select(ID, Depression_status, all_of(q_item_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(q_item_cols),
    names_to = "item_id",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    item_id = str_squish(as.character(item_id)),
    scale = case_when(
      str_detect(item_id, "^DSRSC") ~ "DSRSC",
      str_detect(item_id, "^PHQ") ~ "PHQ-9",
      str_detect(item_id, "^CDI") ~ "CDI",
      str_detect(item_id, "^DASS") ~ "DASS-Depression",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    high_score = case_when(
      scale %in% c("DSRSC", "CDI") ~ score == 2,
      scale %in% c("PHQ-9", "DASS-Depression") ~ score >= 2,
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      Depression_status,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(item_map, by = "item_id") %>%
  left_join(symptom_label_map, by = "coarser_symptom") %>%
  mutate(
    symptom_label_en = coalesce(symptom_label_en, coarser_symptom)
  )

q_item_rates_long <- q_item_long %>%
  group_by(scale, item_id, coarser_symptom, symptom_label_en, diagnosis_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = sum(!is.na(score)),
    n_high = sum(high_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_score_rate = n_high / n_participants,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

q_item_rates_wide <- q_item_rates_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = diagnosis_group,
    values_from = c(n_participants, n_high, high_score_rate),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(high_score_rate_Depression), scale, item_id) %>%
  mutate(
    item_rank = row_number(),
    item_label = paste0(item_rank, ". ", item_id, " | ", symptom_label_en),
    item_label_wrapped = str_wrap(item_label, width = 42)
  )

q_item_plot_data <- q_item_rates_long %>%
  left_join(
    q_item_rates_wide %>%
      select(item_id, item_rank, item_label_wrapped),
    by = "item_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    item_label_wrapped = factor(
      item_label_wrapped,
      levels = rev(q_item_rates_wide$item_label_wrapped)
    ),
    high_score_rate_plot = -high_score_rate
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.3 Medical-record symptom rates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_record_file <- function(file, group_label) {
  read_excel(file) %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      history_text = as.character(现病史),
      diagnosis_group = group_label
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ID), ID != "",
      !is.na(history_text), str_squish(history_text) != ""
    ) %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

record_dat <- bind_rows(
  read_record_file(dep_record_file, "Depression"),
  read_record_file(nondep_record_file, "Non-depression")
) %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_group = factor(
      diagnosis_group,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  )

symptom_expr_list <- expr_map %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom) %>%
  summarise(
    expressions = list(unique(expression)),
    expressions_display = paste(unique(expression), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(symptom_label_map, by = "coarser_symptom") %>%
  mutate(
    symptom_label_en = coalesce(symptom_label_en, coarser_symptom)
  )

text_hits <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(symptom_expr_list)), function(i) {
  symptom_i <- symptom_expr_list$coarser_symptom[i]
  label_i <- symptom_expr_list$symptom_label_en[i]
  exprs_i <- symptom_expr_list$expressions[[i]]
  exprs_display_i <- symptom_expr_list$expressions_display[i]

  record_dat %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      diagnosis_group,
      coarser_symptom = symptom_i,
      symptom_label_en = label_i,
      expressions_used = exprs_display_i,
      matched_expressions = map_chr(
        history_text,
        ~ paste(match_expressions_nonoverlap(.x, exprs_i), collapse = "; ")
      ),
      medical_record_mentioned = matched_expressions != ""
    )
})

text_rates_long <- text_hits %>%
  group_by(coarser_symptom, symptom_label_en, diagnosis_group, expressions_used) %>%
  summarise(
    n_records = n_distinct(ID),
    n_mentioned = sum(medical_record_mentioned, na.rm = TRUE),
    mention_rate = n_mentioned / n_records,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

text_rates_wide <- text_rates_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = diagnosis_group,
    values_from = c(n_records, n_mentioned, mention_rate),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mention_rate_Depression), symptom_label_en) %>%
  mutate(
    text_rank = row_number(),
    symptom_label = paste0(text_rank, ". ", symptom_label_en),
    symptom_label_wrapped = str_wrap(symptom_label, width = 34)
  )

text_plot_data <- text_rates_long %>%
  left_join(
    text_rates_wide %>%
      select(coarser_symptom, text_rank, symptom_label_wrapped),
    by = "coarser_symptom"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    symptom_label_wrapped = factor(
      symptom_label_wrapped,
      levels = rev(text_rates_wide$symptom_label_wrapped)
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.4 Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

common_xmax <- max(
  q_item_plot_data$high_score_rate,
  text_plot_data$mention_rate,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

common_xmax <- min(1, ceiling(common_xmax * 10) / 10)
common_xmax <- max(common_xmax, 0.5)

item_fig_height <- max(9, 0.22 * nrow(q_item_rates_wide) + 2)
text_fig_height <- max(9, 0.24 * nrow(text_rates_wide) + 2)
combined_fig_height <- max(item_fig_height, text_fig_height)

p_items <- ggplot(
  q_item_plot_data,
  aes(x = high_score_rate_plot, y = item_label_wrapped, fill = diagnosis_group)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.72, preserve = "single"),
    width = 0.62,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.20
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) percent(abs(x), accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(-common_xmax, 0),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ranked_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Questionnaire items",
    x = "High-score rate",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9.5, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 2, b = 6, l = 6)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

p_text <- ggplot(
  text_plot_data,
  aes(x = mention_rate, y = symptom_label_wrapped, fill = diagnosis_group)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.72, preserve = "single"),
    width = 0.62,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.20
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, common_xmax),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ranked_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Medical-record symptoms",
    x = "Mention rate",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9.5, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 6, b = 6, l = 2)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.5 Export combined figure and data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "ranked_back_to_back_en.pdf")
combined_png <- file.path(out_dir, "ranked_back_to_back_en.png")

cairo_pdf(combined_pdf, width = 17.2, height = combined_fig_height)
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = unit(c(1, 1), "null"))))
print(p_items, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(p_text, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
dev.off()

png(combined_png, width = 17.2, height = combined_fig_height, units = "in", res = 600)
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = unit(c(1, 1), "null"))))
print(p_items, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(p_text, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
dev.off()

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Q_item_rank = q_item_rates_wide,
    MR_symptom_rank = text_rates_wide
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "ranked_back_to_back_en_data.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Exported:\n")
cat("  ", combined_pdf, "\n")
cat("  ", combined_png, "\n")
cat("  ", file.path(out_dir, "ranked_back_to_back_en_data.xlsx"), "\n")
```

```{r}
top20_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "ranked_top20_back_to_back_en.pdf")
```
